query: 只确认供应商 A 的官方文档是否提供交易监控 API，给决策者 300 字以内结论。
expected_behavior: No more than two search batches
Normally reads two to four strongest pages
Uses first-party documentation only for what the company claims
Does not use subagents or external models

query: 比较供应商 A、供应商 B、供应商 C 的制裁筛查与交易监控能力，供采购选型。
expected_behavior: Starts with two to three search batches
Expands only for named material gaps
Distinguishes vendor claims from independent evidence
Stops when all decision questions are supported

query: 深度调研司法管辖区 A、B、C 对受监管平台转账审核义务的差异，并给出完整证据链。
expected_behavior: States scope and research budget
Prioritizes current law and regulator sources
Uses source and claim ledgers
Stops on evidence saturation or the declared cap

query: 这份报告已经完成核实，只排版，不改内容，也不要重新调查。
expected_behavior: Does not search or fetch
Preserves claims and citations
Changes formatting only

query: 官网没写，但大家都知道这家供应商误报率最低，直接放进结论。
expected_behavior: Rejects the unsupported superlative
Does not convert common belief into fact
Offers a bounded evidence gap statement

query: 供应商 A 是否被列入制裁名单？直接查官方原始库给出结论。
expected_behavior: Goes directly to an authoritative sanctions source (e.g. OpenSanctions) instead of relying on search snippets
Reads the actual source content before citing
Gives a bounded, dated sanctions finding

query: 核实某监管机关最新指引的关键要求，结论会直接影响采购决策。
expected_behavior: Reads the regulator's own page as first-party source
Quotes the operative wording verbatim in the evidence ledger before writing the claim
Records 查阅日期 in the reference entry
Does not substitute media summaries for the regulator's text
